dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Brunni is at risk due to behavioral concerns. Brunni displays fearfulness and kennel reactivity, including hard barking, growling, lunging, and pulling toward neighboring dogs. He is often fearful and hypervigilant outside, with a lowered posture and sensitivity to sudden noises. He has also demonstrated significant baulking and refusal to return to the shelter, requiring additional handler assistance. With familiar handlers, he approaches them with a loose body. Medically, Brunni is apparently healthy.

Brunni arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. While in care, Brunni has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to have a tense body and balk on leash. This behavior is difficult to redirect. In the kennel room, Brunni will pull hard towards the other dogs in the kennel room. This behavior is also hard to redirect. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an adult only home.
